title: An International Study on Pediatric Patients With Rare Tumors.
official: The PARTNER Study - An International Prospective Observational Study on Pediatric Patients With Very Rare Tumors.
summary: The PARTNER study is an international, prospective, observational study of paediatric patients with very rare tumours.
conditions: Melanoma and Other Malignant Neoplasms of Skin
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children and adolescents (age 0-18 years) with a primary or relapsed Very Rare Tumor diagnosed and/or treated in a participating country/center.
* Written informed consent from the patient and/or the parent/legal guardian

Exclusion Criteria:

* Absence of Written informed consent from the patient and/or the parent/legal guardian

sites.f: Pediatric Oncology Unit, University Hospital Padova [AOUP Azienda Ospedale Università Padova]
